simple.meaning: אֶפְרֹחַ (ʼephrôach) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “the brood of a bird.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Deuteronomy 22:6. The surrounding context includes blood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֶפְרֹחַ (H667) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
